_meta.metric: Activity-based Scope 3 factors for Cat 3 (energy WTT/T&D), Cat 6 (business travel), Cat 7 (commuting)
_meta.unit: electricity: kg CO2e/kWh; travel modes: kg CO2e/passenger-km; hotel: kg CO2e/room-night
_meta.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 GHG Conversion Factors (WTT- UK electricity, T&D, Business travel- air/land, Hotel stay)
notes: Cat 3 electricity = purchased grid kWh × (generation WTT + T&D losses + WTT of T&D).
Air factors include radiative forcing (RF) — DEFRA 'With RF', best practice for disclosure.
Travel/commuting are per passenger-km; hotel per room-night by country (default = Germany).

electricity_wtt_td_kg_per_kwh._note: combined = wtt_generation + td_losses + wtt_of_td (kg CO2e per kWh of purchased grid electricity)

flight_wtt_kg_per_pkm._note: DEFRA 2024 'WTT- flights' — upstream (well-to-tank) of aviation fuel, per passenger-km. Scope 3 Cat 3, added on top of the Cat 6 combustion factor. Combustion air factors above are DEFRA 2024 'with RF' (radiative forcing), average passenger.

commuting_defaults._source: screening defaults; refine with a commuting survey (mode split + distance)
